test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements :**

I. All teas are coffees.

II. All coffees are beverages.

III. Some teas are drinks

**Conclusions :**

I. All teas are beverages.

II. No drink is a coffee.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements :

 All teas are coffee.

All coffees are beverages.

Some teas are drinks.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8d8c761551c30b0ac4d3bb19d66ec075614b050002ded0805f4571d7ebdc9a.png] 

Conclusions :

I. All teas are beverages - **True **(Because, All tea are coffee, and all coffee are beverage. So, the part of Coffee which is tea is also beverage)

II. No drink is a coffee - False (There is no definite relation is given between drink and coffee, so it can be possible only)

So, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
